datasets.name: RapidEye satellite images (Lushan)
datasets.verbatim: Optical RapidEye satellite images with spatial resolution of 5 m acquired on May 12, 2013 for the Lushan earthquake... are available from the Planet Explorer [54]. ... [54] Planet Team, Planet application program interface: In space for life on earth, San Francisco, CA, USA, 2017. [Online]. Available: https://api.planet.com

datasets.name: Reference landslide inventories (Lushan and Jiuzhaigou)
datasets.verbatim: the reference landslide inventories for Lushan and Jiuzhaigou, were all obtained based on change detection and visual interpretation of pre-event RapidEye optical images acquired on April 17, 2013 and August 5, 2017, respectively, [53]. To minimize interpretation errors, high spatial resolution remote sensing images, e.g., Google Earth images, and landslide maps interpreted by [50] and [55] were adopted for reference in the process of visual interpretation.

methods.name: LandsNet
methods.summary: A cascaded end-to-end convolutional neural network for landslide detection from single-temporal optical images. It incorporates residual blocks (ResBlock), an attention module to focus on relevant features, and multiscale fusion via sequential dilated convolutions to capture hierarchical dependencies.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is referenced but not linked, and the custom LandsNet code is not provided or linked.
